evidence.note: Labels start at 0: an implicit 0-weight super-source reaches every component.

reference.note: Infeasible systems admit no assignment to verify.

negative_cycle.explanation: Each constraint x - y <= c is the edge y -> x of weight c. Traversing the cycle and summing telescopes the variable differences to 0, so the constraints imply 0 <= -2, which is impossible.

verification.definition: Minimal = removing any single member makes the rest feasible; it is not necessarily the globally smallest such set.
